newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent rallies on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent rallies on short-covering.

text.p: IPE Brent crude oil rallied sharply in late trade on the back of shortcovering both in London and New York, brokers said.
"I don't see any fresh news. It looks like a lot of traders went short early today and have now come back to buy. (NYMEX) gasoline has stabilised the market," one broker said.
Jan Brent leapt up 46 cents on the day to trade at 1834 GMT at $23.23 a barrel, just two cents off the day's high.
Jan gasoline on the NYMEX gained some 1.54 cents a gallon to 66.9 cents
Jan Brent easily took out resistance at $22.95-23.00 and was now heading for the next resistance level at $23.39 a barrel, brokers said.
